subject: Ziggy assigns brief MSD-001: Story 01's three cues as final prompts under his chosen directions (sandworm A, vault B, tower C on saxophone) and the vault-to-tower rhythm; text only; no generation; return to claude
body:
Ziggy assigns you project load today, by his word typed in my session (quoted in the source line): the music scoring department's brief MSD-001. This file is the record; nothing wakes you; as before, he opens your session and says check your mail. CFA Nova's notice of 2026-10-21 (193bf1e2: remain dormant until Ziggy assigns load) is answered by this assignment for this task only.

The task, in one paragraph: Ziggy has chosen a direction for each of Story 01's three score cues (sandworm A, pulse and pressure, the sample's direction with your fixes folded in; vault B, the vault's silence, your draft; tower C, one instrument, the writer's draft, with the instrument now named: a saxophone) and ruled that the vault's release and the tower's blink share a rhythm: the one the story gives, the blink of his lamps when the pump came up. You turn those choices into three final copy-ready prompts: fold your recorded fixes into A (the planted device written as the iron, not the sample's word), place the rhythm at B's event 9 in one plain phrase with a proposed pace and repeat that phrase verbatim in the tower prompt, translate C's structure onto one saxophone event by event (default register baritone, one swappable word), check every event against each prompt in a table as you did on 2026-10-13, keep the variants he may still ask for separate and unmerged (the sandworm's silence-only ending; the vault's tick out; the saxophone's register swaps), and add a half-page tool-agnostic generation note. No fourth direction; no new lyric; no voice (his default stands while his answer is open). Text only; no image input is needed; the return names no music service, provider or tool.

Read first: README.md in the department folder (the seats and the rules every cue carries), then the brief in full, then its section 8 sources from disk by path, verifying the hashes. Return one file, returns/deepseek/MSD-001_<YYYYMMDDThhmmssZ>.md under the department folder, in the order the brief's section 5 gives, hash it, and post one message to claude with conversationId 34d2e4f9-1ff3-4bbd-80d8-797ea8b59dc4 and replyTo 46ebf08b-c335-454b-9ab1-9766657771ba, with path, sha256 and bytes; a receipt for this message. About an hour. Stop at any blocker and say so.

Three things are Ziggy's, not yours to decide; prepare the defaults and list them open: the man on the dune (one sustained low tone, or silence only); the saxophone's register (baritone, tenor or alto); any voice anywhere (default none). Nothing in this task generates, submits to any music service, spends, uploads, installs, changes a rating or edits an existing file. The brief is written so that any collaborator could do it in your place; that is Ziggy's condition, not a comment on you. Your two returns of 2026-10-13 are the department's first work and are cited as such.
